items.description: Copper pipe repair - fittings, pipe section, consumables
items.rationale: Escape of water: a heating pipe failed inside the building, so the repair is covered. Fittings, a pipe section and consumables are covered under 7.1.7(c). A fair price for about a metre of copper pipe plus fittings is roughly 150 EUR.
Trade labour is covered under 7.1.7(g), including the investigation and repair work. About 1.5 days with a helper for part of it comes to roughly 12-14 hours at customary rates.
Re-insulating the repaired section is part of reinstating the pre-loss standard. It covers about 1 m of pipe, so six pieces of insulation are cheap.
One call-out charge per contractor per invoice is covered under 7.1.7(f). Reference cases show a small amount.
Disposing of the removed pipe and insulation counts as debris removal under 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1. The volume is small (one bag), so the cost is low.
General administrative or processing charges on top of itemised labour and materials are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
Cleaning, disinfection and coating of the tiles are general cleanliness and upkeep measures, or an improvement, under 7.1.8(a). The tiles were not physically damaged, so they are not covered.
